dark_souls_animation_plan.title: Dark Souls Quality Animations — From Havok Data to Combat Precision
dark_souls_animation_plan.why: Kenshi combat is about stats, not skill. Dark Souls combat is about timing, positioning, hitboxes. We can bridge both.

current_kenshi_combat.animations: Basic — swing, block, dodge (few frames, no wind-up variation)
current_kenshi_combat.feel: Automated — player gives orders, character auto-fights

target_quality.animations: Per-frame hitbox data, wind-up tells, recovery windows, stamina cost per move
target_quality.hitboxes: Precise mesh-based collision — sword swing arc, not bounding box
target_quality.damage: Skill-based + stat-based hybrid (Dark Souls meets Kenshi)
target_quality.feel: Player can choose to direct-control for precision, or auto-fight for squad management

pipeline.step_3: Design new animations in Blender with IK, physics-based cloth/hair
pipeline.step_4: Define hitbox volumes per frame using Blender's collision shapes
pipeline.step_6: Test in Kenshi via KenshiLua hot-reload (Wood Age)
pipeline.step_7: In Rust age: replace Havok with Rapier physics, Ogre with WGPU
